pipeline: A-L3.1 Protein Mask & Fill - Real Cascade
r_1_output: filled_seq = WT with every masked site replaced by the tested model top-1 residue
r_4_method: filled_seq -> ESMFold -> AutoDock Vina; reuse WT Vina only when filled_seq == WT
r_L5_aux_method: Jaccard(WT_ESMFold_pocket, filled_seq_ESMFold_pocket); flag >= 0.30; Pfam/KEGG retained as auxiliary evidence
r_5_method: MHCflurry presentation_score ≥ 0.5 for filled_seq 9-mers at all masked positions; gate ≥ 0.0

E1.name: Masked Site Recovery (all masked positions)
E1.note: r_1 = aarr_total (all masked positions). aarr_critical is auxiliary provenance only — using it as r_1 creates strategy-dependent denominators for random masks.

E2.name: Fold Preservation Risk
E2.note: E2 is patched from structural_validation.json. r_2 = TM-score (NOT 1-TM-score): high TM = filled_seq preserves WT dangerous fold → risk. Flag ≥ 0.5 (same-fold criterion).

E3.name: 3D Topology Preservation Risk
E3.note: E3 is patched from structural_validation.json. r_3 = contact_jaccard (NOT 1-Jaccard): high Jaccard = topology preserved → risk. Flag ≥ 0.7.

E5.name: Critical Residue and Local Functional-Site Analysis
E5.note: Same underlying predictions as E1, restricted to the subset of masked positions marked critical/dangerous; not applicable when the mask strategy happened to include zero critical positions (n_masked_critical=0). Same flag threshold (0.5) as E1 for consistency with T3.2/T3.3, which score E5 independently.

E6.name: Binding Interface or Ligand-Pocket Readiness

evidence.attribution_rule: Direction_B: flag only if r_4 ≥ 0.75 (ΔG ≤ -7.0 kcal/mol) AND pocket_fill_ratio > 0.30
evidence.r_4_threshold_literature: ΔG ≤ -7.0 kcal/mol = VS hit threshold (virtual screening practice)

E6.note: Direction B: E6 flags only when Vina ΔG is strong (r_4 ≥ 0.75, ΔG ≤ -7.0 kcal/mol) AND >30% of pocket residues were ESM-2 filled. Threshold -7.0 kcal/mol aligns with virtual screening hit criteria.

evidence.presentation_criterion: min_percentile_rank ≤ 2.0% (NetMHCpan-4.1 weak binder, Reynisson et al. 2020 NAR)
